description: Shared definitions for canvas scenes: a JSON Canvas 1.0-shaped node and edge with integer geometry, an explicit order, and an open union of node content.

node.description: A node on the canvas. The frame (id, geometry, order, colour, ref) is the same for every node, so a reader can place a node whose content it does not understand. The content is an open union keyed by NSID.

id.description: Local stable id, unique within the scene. Edges and per-user overrides refer to it.

x.description: Left edge in canvas units (JSON Canvas: pixels).

y.description: Top edge in canvas units (JSON Canvas: pixels).

order.description: Explicit stacking order, ascending = bottom to top (the JSON Canvas array-order rule, made a field because array position is not merge-safe). Ties are broken by id.

color.description: JSON Canvas canvasColor: a hex colour such as #FF0000, or a preset '1'..'6'.

ref.description: The record this node represents. The same record may be referenced by more than one node.

content.description: What the node holds. Open union: a third party may add a variant under its own NSID, and readers must tolerate variants they do not know.

text.description: JSON Canvas 'text' node: plain text with Markdown syntax.

file.description: JSON Canvas 'file' node. The path is opaque and system-local; to point at an atproto record use the node's ref.

subpath.description: Link to a heading or block inside the file; starts with '#'.

group.description: JSON Canvas 'group' node: a visual container. Membership is spatial (the group's rectangle), as in JSON Canvas; there is no nesting field.

component.description: A plugin component placed on the canvas (the Inlay window model: componentUri + props).

componentUri.description: The component to render, usually the at-uri of its record.

props.description: Props for the component: a JSON object with no floats (atproto data model).

canvas.description: A nested canvas: another scene shown inside this node's frame. Rendering a nested scene is up to the reader; a reader that cannot do so shows a placeholder.

scene.description: The at-uri of the ing.lexicon.canvas.scene record to show.

edge.description: A JSON Canvas 1.0 edge, stored in the scene record.

fromNode.description: Id of the node where the connection starts.

toNode.description: Id of the node where the connection ends.
